docs.text: Azilehub Academy About Azilehub Academy Azilehub Academy provides deep technical learning pathways focused on the intersection of robust DevOps pipelines and scalable MLOps environments. In an era where infrastructure automation meets artificial intelligence, engineers need holistic mastery over container runtimes, monitoring frameworks, and accelerated cluster schedulers. Our curriculum is built on real-world engineering paradigms. Whether you are establishing local and cloud container architectures via Docker and Kubernetes, setting up metric-driven observability with Prometheus and Grafana, or scaling deep learning models across Slurm and HPC clusters, our tutorials offer step-by-step clarity. We empower practitioners to master Linux server operating systems, track code via Version Control systems, and build scalable machine learning architectures using PyTorch, Hugging Face, and MLflow. MISSION: To equip engineers and system administrators with hands-on, end-to-end expertise across containerized platforms, high-performance workload orchestrators, and production AI stacks to power modern enterprise and research infrastructure. Learning Tutorials & Modules Explore our core engineering tracks: Linux / Git Ubuntu / Debian: standard server operating systems. RHEL / Rocky Linux: enterprise-grade distributions. Systemd: system and service manager. SSH: secure remote access protocol. [see more] Version Control Git: decentralized source code tracking. GitHub / GitLab: cloud hosting and collaboration. Bitbucket: enterprise source control platform. SVN: centralized version control system. [see more] Containerization Docker: container creation and management. Kubernetes: container orchestration and scaling. Podman: rootless alternative to Docker. Helm: package manager for Kubernetes. [see more] Monitoring Prometheus: time-series data collection engine. Grafana: metric visualization and dashboards. ELK Stack: log aggregation and analysis. Datadog / Dynatrace: cloud-scale application monitoring. [see more] HPC (High-Performance Computing) PBS: Altair PBSPro. Slurm: cluster management and job scheduling. MPI: message passing for parallel computing. Singularity / Apptainer: HPC-optimized container runtimes. Lustre: high-performance parallel file system. [see more] AI/ML PyTorch / TensorFlow: core deep learning frameworks. Hugging Face: transformer models and datasets. Scikit-learn: machine learning data analysis. MLflow / WandB: experiment tracking and MLOps. [see more] Featured Stacks DEVOPS CI/CD & Infrastructure Linux, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm MLOPS & AI Inference & Experiment Tracking PyTorch, Hugging Face, MLflow, Scikit-learn HPC & MONITORING Cluster Schedulers & Metrics Slurm, PBS Pro, Prometheus, Grafana What Our Students Say "The Slurm and Kubernetes cluster tutorials gave me the exact hands-on exposure I needed for enterprise infrastructure management!" — Alex Chen, Senior Systems Engineer "Deploying PyTorch and Hugging Face workflows with actual production configurations made mastering MLOps straightforward and practical." — Priya Sharma, MLOps Practitioner "Azilehub Academy bridges the gap between traditional Linux administration and modern AI stack deployment brilliantly." — David Miller, Cloud Architect Trending Tutorials Popular among engineers right now: GPU CLUSTERS: Slurm & PBS Pro Multi-Node Setup Guide AI INFERENCE: Scaling Transformers with PyTorch & Hugging Face OBSERVABILITY: Advanced Prometheus Alerting & Grafana Dashboards Mentorship & Contributions Are you passionate about DevOps automation, cluster orchestration, or AI model serving architectures? Azilehub Academy collaborates with experienced engineers and technical writers to build comprehensive open-source learning paths. We welcome community contributions, technical guides, and project walkthroughs. If you want to share your expertise or collaborate on curriculum development, reach out to our team at azilehub@gmail.com . Contact Contact us for tutorial inquiries, enterprise training, or mentorship programs. 📍 Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, Pin-560070. 📞 +91 80 2654 2726 ✉️ azilehub@gmail.com (Note: To submit a direct inquiry, please email us directly with your Name, Email, and Message.)
